text: {"score":3,"justification":"The core numbers match the card: 24.2% of 244 claims, expected 2.6%, risk-adjusted 7.51, z 3.69, 63% low complexity, 11 documented 99215 with 0 below billed, 8% comparison rate, 9 of 26 with no lab. The leaning is cautious and the 'thin base' caveat is appropriate. The unmatched numbers (13, 27, 10) are note-check percentages that appear to come from tool output not shown on the card, so they are likely grounded but unverifiable here. However, the narrative makes claim-level assertions that the card does not support. It says C0082883 is flagged late, bulk-created, paste-heavy and for data, and that C0083037 was bulk-created, yet the card carries no per-claim note flags. It also names C0082883 and C0082948 as URI, and C0082949 and C0083037 as low back pain, but those diagnoses are only partly verifiable. The headline says 'every returned 99215 chart documents high MDM', which is based on 11 charts and four examples. The summary also mentions 'duplicate' flags that are not in the listed stats. Next steps are inconsistent: the prose recommends reading the full notes for C0082883, C0083037 and C0082872, while the formal next steps cite only C0082819 and C0082837, for which no documentation was returned. Those two example claims are generic and not the strongest ones.
